salvage: All four complete arguments and three primary runners recommended for canonical salvage; source packaging and evidence remain pending.
claims_and_boundaries: Ground magnetic event theorem: supplied full compact rotor H on even spatial tori L>=4, fixed positive g<=1 and fixed observation spacing T. Positive simple ground lies in neutral Gauss/zero-electric-flux sector. Trial energy, site/time conditional-square reflection positivity, chessboard disjoint-cell placement, N/4 disjoint-face packing and M/2 sampled-time duplication yield exponent 1/8. Mixed orientations pay ceil(k/3).

Whole-interval magnetic theorem: action-or-Brownian-escape bound from any starting configuration. Actual constrained kernel is symmetric pointwise nonnegative, not assumed positive semidefinite. Hilbert-Schmidt/even trace powers yield exponent 1/4. Magnetic cover clusters use witness multiplicity two, orientation loss three and degree eight.

Path limit theorem: reversible forward/backward cancellation yields 3 g^4 a^4 h^2 for scalar functions and 12 g^4 h^2 for circle chords. Countable-link compactness gives subsequential continuous paths. Bounded finite-range compact bridge specification passes by continuity; correct open-threshold Portmanteau argument transfers excursions. No uniqueness, limiting SDE drift or free-box identification.

Coarse-current theorem: N/4 distinct disseminated link Brownian coordinates yield temporal oscillation bound. Fixed temporal gauge and fixed positive time block define an exact compact cochain. Principal branch on positive orientations and antisymmetric extension give J=-dm, dJ=0. Fourfold face incidence and six orientations yield 1/24 exponent; degree fourteen gives 196 p_J criterion. Finite integer currents decompose into cycles. No microscopic T->0 limit, exhaustive harmonic sectors, physical electric reconstruction, photon or native Hamiltonian selection.

manual: Conditional-square proof: boundary link paths are fixed by site reflection; no plaquette meets both open halves. Brownian reference and potential factor by half. Time reflection analog fixes endpoint configurations.

Chessboard proof works on these half-algebras; link sign flips and time reversal commute by coordinate, arbitrary even rectangular counts follow dimensionwise Cauchy-Schwarz. Sampled face/time repetitions paid explicitly; no independence assertion.

Schur row bounds follow dropping nonnegative potentials and retaining disjoint Brownian coordinates. Ground limit carries exp(W E0). Whole-interval K need not be PSD; even-power trace inequality is valid.

Martingale fourth moment coefficient: Ito yields3b²h² per martingale; the halves and |x-y|⁴ bound retain coefficient3; cos/sin combine to12. Specification normalized denominator lower bound is exp(-2 n(S)(b-a)/g²).
Witness losses: magnetic6 choices with2 face-incidence and3 orientations; coarse6 choices with4 face-incidence and6 orientations. Connected-set tree walk length2s-2 yields degree² criterion.
Binary plaquette two-state H has offdiag -4g² and potential contrast2/g²: normalized bad-state probability is4g^8+O(g^16).
